hints.title: Skyline Constraint Bounds
hints.text: The maximum allowable height for any building is bounded by the minimum of its row maximum and column maximum.

hints.title: Row and Column Maximum Precomputation
hints.text: Precalculate the maximum value in each row and each column in advance.

hints.title: Direct Grid Summation
hints.text: Iterate over all cells and add min(row_max[r], col_max[c]) minus original cell value to the answer.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Precomputes row and column maximums followed by linear grid traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing row and column bounds per cell costs O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two arrays of size N store the skyline projections.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precalculate projections and compute cell increments independently.
